gif-maker/how_to_use/delay_desc: A smaller delay makes the animation faster; a larger delay slows it down.
gif-maker/how_to_use/download_desc: Preview the result and download it as a .gif file.
gif-maker/how_to_use/generate_desc: Click the Generate button and the GIF is created locally in your browser.
gif-maker/how_to_use/order_desc: Drag images in the list to arrange the frame order of your animation.
gif-maker/how_to_use/settings_desc: Choose frame delay, output width, quality, loop count, background color and dithering.
gif-maker/how_to_use/upload_images_desc: Add the images you want to animate. You can upload several at once by clicking, dragging or pasting.
gif-maker/message/no_images: Upload at least one image to get started.
gif-maker/note: Create an animated GIF from a sequence of uploaded images.
gif-maker/setting/background_color_hint: Fills the transparent areas of the frames.
gif-maker/setting/delay_hint: How long each frame is shown. 100ms is roughly 10 FPS.
gif-maker/setting/dither_hint: Dithering smooths color gradients but may increase file size. Try turning it on for photos and off for flat-color graphics.
gif-maker/tags: gif, gif maker, create gif, animation, images to gif, animated image
gif-maker/tips/format: Supports JPG, PNG and WebP images.
gif-maker/tips/frame_size: Frames with different sizes are scaled to the same width and centered.
gif-maker/tips/quality: Lower quality produces a smaller file but may reduce color depth.
gif-maker/tips/transparency: Transparent PNG frames are filled with the selected background color.
